handbookNote: West Virginia Real Estate Broker license exam. Part of the 2026-09-03 R26 population-tier broker buildout (population order: UT > NV > IA > AR > KS > MS > ID > NE > WV > HI > NH > MT > RI > DE > SD > ND > AK > VT > WY). Exam vendor: Pearson VUE, under contract with the West Virginia Real Estate Commission. Exam mechanics confirmed via Pearson VUE's own official Candidate Handbook #094900 (February 2026) and Content Outline #094905. National/general portion: 80 scored items (+5 pretest), 150 minutes. West Virginia state portion (Broker): 60 scored items (+5 pretest), 90 minutes. Total 140 scored items, 4 hours. Passing score is a proprietary SCALED score of 75 (Broker; Salesperson uses 70) on EACH section independently -- a candidate who passes one and fails the other retakes only the failed part within the 90-day authorization window. track_registry models this as exam_question_count=140, exam_duration_sec=14400, pass_percent=75, min_correct=105 (round(140*0.75)), same convention as UT/NV/KS/ID Broker. NATIONAL PORTION (80 items) reuses the exact same real Pearson VUE national item bank as Utah/Nevada/Kansas/Idaho/Nebraska -- West Virginia's real Broker outline weights are IDENTICAL (10/8/10/15/12/9/8/8 across the same 8 sections). WEST VIRGINIA STATE PORTION (60 items, real Broker item counts): General Powers and Duties of the Real Estate Commission (9, incl. audits/complaints/investigations/hearings/penalties -- no WV recovery fund exists, confirmed absent, WV Code 30-40-9 only describes the license fund), Licensing (14, incl. license maintenance/renewal/CE, activities requiring a license, and all 10 real WV Code 30-40-5(c) licensure exemptions), Real Estate Practice (11, scope of practice/fees and advertising rules under 174 CSR 1), Agency Relationships (4) and West Virginia Fair Housing (4, combined into one drafting pass -- WV's Fair Housing Act was RECODIFIED in 2024 (SB 300), moved from the old W. Va. Code 5-11A to the current 16B-18; WV's protected classes notably ADD ancestry and blindness beyond the federal Fair Housing Act's list), and Broker Management (18, largest state section -- real trust fund rules under 30-40-18 incl. the $100 broker personal-funds allowance, place of business/branch office rules under 30-40-17, brokerage operation/management, and human resources management). Governing law: West Virginia Code Chapter 30, Article 40, and 174 CSR 1 (WV Real Estate Commission's legislative rule, effective 4/7/2026). This bank was drafted across 5 new state-topic drafting passes (the 8 national files were reused, not redrafted). Answers were deterministically rotated into final A/B/C/D position via scripts/tracks/rotate_broker_answers.js.
